title: Spotify's AI DJ Gets 9 New Voices and Can Finally Talk Less
description:
Spotify's AI DJ just got nine new voices (seven English, two Spanish) with British, American, Irish, Australian and Indian accents.
A new setting cuts the chatter: the DJ only speaks when your session starts or when you ask for different music.
